about: WP7 v2 (Tag): WP7: the blended video's mix (Draft 3's audio/mix.json, re-timed). The music bed and the sound effects, and where they sit. Read by render.mjs and tools/mix.mjs: music {file, gain_db, in, fade_in, fade_out, duck_ratio, duck_attack, duck_release}, sfx [{id, file, at, gain_db}], master {target, ceiling, voiceRms}. Times are film seconds; files are relative to demo-video/film/. Every other field here is a note for people and is ignored by the mix. Sources and terms: audio/SOURCES.md.

music.note: bed-blended-v2.wav: the same take re-cut on v2's bars (audio/music/bed-blended-v2.edl.json). bed.wav is cut on the film's bar lines (120 BPM, one bar = 2.0 s, film time 0 = file time 0) and already carries its own level ride, start and ending, so the fades here are only guards. duck_release is 900 ms (the default is 420): with 420 the music came back up inside the pauses of a line and three lines stood under 10 dB above it; with 900 every line stands 15 dB or more above it. Alternate: audio/music/bed-alt-1.wav (same loudness: change only the file name). How each bed is cut: audio/music/*.edl.json.

sfx.note: the phone lights up in the sleeper close-up (clip 3.5 s at rate 0.8 from 1.8)
shimmer as the tag slides out of the phone and glides across the room
rising whoosh; its end on the cut into the walkthrough at 22.0
soft swish on the cut to Zoom
the same, brighter, on the cut to Slack
the reveal's shimmer, quieter, as the tag goes back into his phone on the desk
his click on his answer in the laptop brief
one warm chime with the end card

sfx_note: To move an effect, set at = event_s - sync_s (sync_s is the moment inside the file that belongs on the picture event; audio/sfx/sfx.json lists it per file). All effects are made by audio/sfx/make_sfx.py.
master_note: ceiling is -2.5, not -1.5: the limiter in tools/mix.mjs holds SAMPLE peaks 0.3 dB under the ceiling, and the true peak of this mix then comes out about 1 dB higher (measured: ceiling -2.0 gave a true peak of -1.3 dBFS in the AAC file, -2.5 gave -1.8, -3.0 gave -2.5). -2.5 keeps the film file under -1.5 dBFS true peak.
